about_the_game:
Goblin Gang! If you simply can't get enough of GLUM and beating down enemies with your boot, why not do it in style? The golden boot is waiting you! Or as we call it, the Midas Boot! You support us directly and as well as the development of the game, and from this pack you exclusively get: 

  • A boot made of solid gold (in game of course)

  • A unique sound when you hit enemies with your boot of solid gold (in game of course)

  • A heartful thanks and eternal gratitude <3 (maybe also a role on our Discord)

Important note: By buying this DLC you are first and foremost showing your support for the game and for CinderCat Games as developers and for that we can't thank you enough.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400 / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

short_description: In this unique “First-Person Booter” you take on the role as Glum, the crude ass-kicking goblin with his magical ass-kicking boot. Indulge in wacky physics-based combat, over-the-top violence and dark humour with a dash of platforming and points for being extra stylish and sadistic.
supported_languages:
English*, Danish, Russian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
